source_title: Idaho Transportation Department — Ports of Entry / Special Permits (IDAPA 39.03.10; Idaho Code 49-1004)
verify_reasons: Official ITD/Port permit pages and the oversize aggregator returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch this run; escort matrix, superload limits and fee schedule were reconstructed from ITD's published summaries and industry regulation guides, not read from the ITD manual directly — confirm with ITD Special Permits (208-334-8420).
Escort thresholds below are 2-lane values (route colors Red/Black/White vary); confirm per-route configuration.

Overweight is a weight-distance road-use fee (approx $0.04/mile just over legal up to ~$1.02/mile at high weight; ~$0.05/ton-mile over 80,000 lbs); only the ~$33 administrative base is codified — confirm the current schedule.

superload_thresholds.note: Beyond ITD's routine online-permit limits (about 16' wide, 15'6" high, 110' long) or over 129,000 lbs GVW, a superload permit is required with route analysis, engineering review and local coordination.

width.note: may require up to 3 escorts over 16' wide

height.note: 1 height-pole escort over 16' high on both 2-lane and Interstate routes

single_trip.fee_formula: Administrative base fee about $33 per single-trip permit. Overweight adds a weight-distance road-use fee (roughly $0.04/mile just over legal, rising by weight tier to about $1.02/mile at high weight; approx $0.05/ton-mile over 80,000 lbs). Quote via permits4idaho / ITD Special Permits.
single_trip.note: Oversize single-trip base is the administrative fee; overweight is schedule-based, not flat.

annual.note: Annual non-reducible OSOW permit $128 for 12 months plus quarterly mileage reports.

movement_restrictions: Oversize moves generally daylight-only (about 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset); night travel per permit for within-limit loads
Metropolitan and holiday curfews may apply per permit and route color
notes: Idaho prices overweight by weight-and-distance (road-use fee), so a gross-weight-only verdict is indicative — confirm the ITD quote.
State-level rules only; live sourcing of the official ITD page was attempted and 403-blocked this run — values cross-referenced and marked for state confirmation.
